title: Cheap quality for the expensive price.
text: Cheap quality for the expensive price.. For the price, these are very thin and flimsy. Plus they are very hard to iron. Would not recommend.

features: Oversize ruffle design 100% cotton voile for vintage and natural feel Rod pocket top finish
100% cotton voile, oversized ruffle, rod pocket

MACHINE WASH COLD, GENTLE CYCLE, AND SEPARATELY. DO NOT BLEACH. TUMBLE DRY LOW, REMOVE PROMPTLY. DO NOT IRON. IF THERE IS NO FREE MOVEMENT IN THE WASHER OR DRYER, USE LARGE CAPACITY COMMERCIAL WASHER/DRYER.
description: Vintage chic meets southern charm with the Madison Park Anna Window Curtain. This window panel features oversized ruffles in a soft blush hue that adds charm and sophistication to your home décor. Made from 100% cotton voile, this window curtain is sure to freshen any room with its natural feel and classic look. Hang using the rod pocket top for a simple finish. Fits up to a 1.25" diameter rod.
